Use the Form pattern. - A whole request failed, not one file. Use the Error recovery pattern. - The list of already-stored files is the point, with no new uploads. Use a `Table` or a list of `ListItem`s. ## Decision rules - Two ways in, always both: a drop target and a "Choose files" `Button` that opens the native picker. Dropping is a shortcut, never the only path (keyboard, touch and assistive tech use the button). - State the limits before the user picks: accepted types, maximum size, maximum count, as helper text under the drop target. Reject a file that breaks a limit immediately, per file, with the reason; do not start its upload and do not reject the others. - Each chosen file becomes one `ListItem` row (`variant="outline"`, `size="sm"`) below the drop target: file name as title, size or status as description, one trailing action. Files upload in parallel and independently. - Per-file status decides the row: - queued / uploading: a determinate `Progress` (`value` from the real byte count, `valueLabel` "42%") under the name; trailing action is a Cancel icon `Button`. Use `indeterminate` only while the size is unknown. - done: a `Badge variant="success"` "Uploaded"; trailing action is Remove. - failed: a `Badge variant="danger"` "Failed", the cause in the row description ("Connection lost", "Larger than 10 MB"), no progress bar; trailing action is a `Button variant="outline" size="sm"` "Retry" (`loading` while it retries) beside Remove. - Classify the failure as in Error recovery. A transient failure (network, timeout, 5xx) offers Retry with the same file. A rejected file (too large, wrong type) offers only Remove: retrying the same file will fail again. - Retry re-uploads only that file; the others are untouched. Keep the failed row in place and in order. Never clear the list on failure. - When two or more files have failed, add one `Alert variant="danger"` above the list ("2 files didn't upload") with a "Retry all" action for the retryable ones. One failed file needs no Alert, its row is enough. - Removing an uploaded file is undoable by re-adding it; do not confirm. Only use `AlertDialog` if removal deletes data on the server that cannot be restored. - A submit action that depends on the files (Save, Send) stays disabled while any file is uploading, and is enabled with failed files present only when the form allows submitting without them; say so in the Alert. ## Components and variants - `Alert` variant: `danger` · size: `md` - `Badge` variant: `success`, `danger` · size: `sm` - `Button` variant: `outline`, `ghost` · size: `sm`, `md` - `Card` variant: `outlined` · size: `md` - `ListItem` variant: `outline` · size: `sm` - `Progress` ## Layout and density - Drop target on top, full width of the content column: a `Card variant="outlined"` holding an icon, one instruction line, the limits as helper text and the "Choose files" Button. The drop target stays visible after files are added so more can be added. - Within a row: file name, then status or progress, then actions at the end edge. - Typography: the instruction line `--atlas-text-body`, limits and row descriptions `--atlas-text-body-sm`.
